concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-045 ('Edge inclusion is based solely on the correlation threshold; adjusted p‑values must not affect edge selection') is not referenced by any task nor covered by description. No task validates that edge selection ignores adjusted p‑values, leaving this FR unimplemented.

The implementation plan (spec.md) declares a master_results.json file as the Single Source of Truth, but no task creates, validates, or writes this artifact. Absence of a task means the plan element is uncovered.
